newsitem.title: USA: Unit Corp sells gas from two new wells.
newsitem.headline: Unit Corp sells gas from two new wells.

text.p: Unit Corp said on Tuesday that it wholly owned subsidiary, Unit Petroleum Co, was selling gas from two new Oklahoma wells.

In a statement, the company said the first well, Deal 2, was drilled to a total depth of 11,200 feet and is currently producing 2.2 million cubic feet of natural gas per day with a flowing tubing pressure of 1,500 pounds from the Morrow formation.
Unit also said it had completed its Dorsey 1 well, which reached a total depth of 19,560 feet and began producing natural gas at the rate of 2.25 million cubic feet per day.
Unit is the operator and owns 50 percent of the Deal 2 well and 41.35 percent of the Dorsey 1 well.
